settings.memory_hint: Adjust memory and file usage. The defaults suit most PCs.
settings.checking_hint: Balance verification speed against memory, disk, and processor use.
settings.checking_memory_hint: 1–1024 MiB per checking torrent. Default: 4 MiB. More outstanding reads may speed up checks but use more memory. Large pieces or more checking threads can exceed this target.
settings.hashing_threads_hint: 1–64 threads. Default: 1. Keep 1 for hard drives. More threads may speed up checks on SSDs, but increase processor and memory use. This does not change checks during downloading.
settings.file_pool_hint: 1–10000 files. Default: 40. More open files can help when seeding many torrents, but use more resources. A lower limit means reopening files more often.
settings.invalid_range: Enter a whole number from {0:N0} to {1:N0}.
settings.downloads_hint: Folders and filenames for new torrents.
settings.use_incomplete_folder: Use a separate folder for incomplete downloads
settings.incomplete_folder_hint: Applies to new torrents. When a download finishes, its files move to the download folder chosen when it was added.
settings.append_suffix_hint: Applies to new torrents. The extension is removed when each file finishes downloading. Existing downloads keep their current naming choice.
settings.confirm_exit: Ask before exiting with active transfers
settings.confirm_exit_hint: Exit stops transfers. Closing the window keeps them running in the notification area.
settings.show_external_ip: Show external IP in the status bar
settings.external_ip_hint: Shows the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses reported by the torrent network, when available.
settings.disk_buffer_hint: 1–1024 MiB. Default: 100 MiB. A lower limit can reduce memory used by pending disk writes, but may slow downloads. This is not a limit on total memory use.
settings.power_hint: Keep the PC awake for transfers.
settings.updates_hint: Look for new versions of TinyTorrent.
settings.speed_hint: Limits for all torrents together. 0 means unlimited.
settings.queue_hint: Torrents beyond these numbers wait in the queue.
settings.seeding_hint: Reaching either limit pauses the torrent and keeps its files. 0 means unlimited.
settings.show_add_hint: When off, opening a torrent file or magnet link adds it to the default folder without opening the window. Downloads follow your queue and pause settings.
settings.encryption_hint: Preferred: encrypt the data with every peer that supports it. Required: connect only to peers that encrypt. Allowed: encrypt the data when the peer asks for it. Disabled: plain connections only. Encryption makes torrent traffic harder for network providers to detect. It does not hide your IP address.
settings.proxy_hint: Send peer and tracker connections through a proxy server.
settings.proxy_working: The proxy is working. Peer and tracker connections go through it.
settings.proxy_port_hint: Peers cannot connect to you through a proxy, so this setting is off while the proxy is in use.
settings.proxy_type_tip: SOCKS5 works with every torrent feature. HTTP and SOCKS4 cannot carry DHT, uTP, or UDP trackers, so those stop while the proxy is in use.
settings.socks4_tip: SOCKS4 does not use a user name or password.
settings.invalid_host: Enter a host name or an IP address.
settings.check_tip: Connect to the proxy with these values, without saving them
settings.proxy_save_tip: Use these proxy settings for peer and tracker connections
settings.proxy_signed_in_tip: The proxy answered in {0} ms and accepted the user name and password.
settings.proxy_sign_in_failed_tip: The proxy did not accept the user name or password.
settings.proxy_unreachable_tip: Nothing answered at {0}:{1}. Check the address and port.
settings.proxy_wrong_type_tip: The server at {0}:{1} is not a {2} proxy.
settings.proxy_timed_out_tip: The proxy did not answer within 10 seconds.
settings.adapter_hint: Send all torrent traffic through one adapter, for example a VPN.
settings.port_mapping: Forward the port on my router (UPnP / NAT-PMP)
settings.mapping_hint: More peers can connect when the router forwards the port.
settings.port_hint: Other peers connect to TinyTorrent on this port.
settings.notifications_hint: Windows notifications appear while the TinyTorrent window is closed.
settings.notify_added: Notify when a torrent is added
settings.prevent_sleep: Prevent sleep while downloading on mains power
settings.prevent_sleep_seeding: Also prevent sleep while seeding on mains power
settings.timeline_hint: Drag empty time to add. Drag a period or its handles to move or resize it on all its days. Snaps to 15 minutes and saves on release; Esc cancels the drag.
settings.timeline_name: Weekly schedule. {0}. Use arrow keys to choose a day and time, Space or Enter to open a period, and Enter on empty time to add one. Esc closes the period.
settings.duplicate_period: A period with these days, times and limits already exists. Choose different values.

settings.torrent_default: Magnet links open with TinyTorrent. Choose TinyTorrent for torrent files in Windows Settings.
settings.handlers_broken: Torrents are set to open with a program that is missing: {0}
settings.repair_defaults_tip: Remove the missing program's entries and open torrents with TinyTorrent.
settings.invalid_count: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
settings.invalid_port: Enter a whole number from 1 to 65,535.
settings.schedule_hint: Repeats in local time. Standard limits apply outside periods; pause takes precedence on overlap. Overnight periods end the following day.
settings.add_period_tip: Add a period to the weekly schedule
settings.appearance_hint: Choose the language and colors of TinyTorrent.
settings.show_splash: Show the splash screen while opening
settings.start_in_tray_hint: Only the notification-area icon appears. Opening TinyTorrent again shows the window.
